name: Guangya Storage
description: First-party Guangya HTTP cloud storage media source. Installable package identity for approval UI; process still starts via compose or node. Host dispatches via the StorageProvider registry (id=guangya); endpoint from FBZ_STORAGE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_guangya or legacy FBZ_GUANGYA_PLUGIN_URL. Plugin communication and host encryption keys stay in deployment secrets only — never in this manifest.

permissions.reason: Bind Guangya accounts via device-code login and refresh host-held credentials.
List cloud directories and read small sidecars (NFO/images/subtitles) for mounts.
Resolve short-lived HTTPS playback URLs for host-authorized streaming.
Expose cloud-discovered library trees and mount paths to the host for media-library association.
